## Dating App User Behavior Analysis

**Tools:** Tableau, Exploratory Data Analysis, Data Visualization

Analyzed user behavior and preferences across three dating app datasets: OkCupid, Lovoo, and Kaggle.

As part of a collaborative project, explored relationships between user demographics, dating preferences, lifestyle characteristics, and engagement metrics using data visualization and regression analysis.
